name: com.leonarndt.masontile
description: Text-first tilemap editing for creators and LLM agents. Read and write tilemaps as character grids, undoable fill/line/flood-fill/cave commands, a text view window, and Unity AI Assistant tools (enabled automatically when com.unity.ai.assistant is installed).

samples.description: Two-level side-scroller: coins, spikes and a goal flag as tiles, levels as text files loaded at runtime.
A village with grid movement, houses, a pond and readable signs. Walkability comes from each tile's collider type.
